name: session-autoname
description: Names background agent sessions after the overarching project they are working on, refreshed each turn by a cheap Haiku call and held steady until the project itself changes.

interface.shortDescription: Background agent sessions named after the project, not the step.
interface.longDescription: Installs a machine-level Stop hook that keeps each background Claude Code agent session named after the overarching project it is working toward, using a cheap Haiku call over the owner's own requests. The name holds steady until the project itself changes, so a long session stops lying in the job list without the label churning every few minutes.
defaultPrompt: Set up the session autonamer on this machine
Stop my background sessions keeping stale names
